provides.port: v0.8 gov crossings (SQL functions on PostgreSQL 18), pinned and digest-checked
embedded PostgreSQL 18 cluster primitives and durable file writes
local data-home write admission and descriptor-owned file exclusion

owns: planes, contracts, runs, crossings, verdicts, receipts and effect attempts of the v0.8 kernel (schemas app, gov, sec, ops)
data.export: not built: the audit export (gov.dump_crossing_rows) is the only read of the whole record so far

exemptions.reason: the kernel's acceptance runs in the kernel lab (parity, effects, crossing, mutation) at the pinned commit; this package refuses any other bytes

swap: a newer kernel commit, pinned after its own independent acceptance
